name: AI Ghost Photoshoot: The Sheet Ghost Trend From One Photo
blurb: The ghost photoshoot (also spelled ghost photo shoot) is the October trend where people pose under a white bedsheet with round black sunglasses on top, alone, with friends or with their dog, in a fall setting.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's height, body shape and skin tone, and keep the clothes that show below the sheet exactly the same as in the photo: the same trousers or skirt and the same shoes. The person is dressed as a classic sheet ghost for the viral ghost photoshoot: a plain white cotton bedsheet covers the head and the upper body and falls in soft, natural folds to just above the knees, rounded on top like a cartoon ghost, with two small cut-out eye holes. A pair of round black sunglasses sits on the sheet over the eye holes. The face and hair are fully hidden under the sheet. One hand comes out from under the sheet and holds a takeaway coffee cup. The ghost stands in the middle of a path covered in orange and yellow fallen leaves in an autumn park, tall trees in fall colors behind, golden afternoon light. Full body from the top of the sheet to the shoes, camera at chest height. Soft 35mm film photo, warm muted colors, natural grain, slight vignette, a real photo, not a costume shop picture. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person, no text, no logos.

Use the two uploaded images as the base. Keep each person's height, body shape and skin tone, and keep the clothes that show below each sheet exactly the same as in their own photo: the same trousers or skirt and the same shoes. Do not blend the two people. Both people are dressed as classic sheet ghosts for the viral ghost photoshoot with friends: each wears a plain white cotton bedsheet that covers the head and the upper body and falls in soft, natural folds to just above the knees, rounded on top like a cartoon ghost, with two small cut-out eye holes, and a pair of round black sunglasses on the sheet over the eye holes. Their faces and hair are fully hidden under the sheets. The person from the first image stands on the left and holds a small orange pumpkin; the person from the second image stands on the right and holds a bunch of dried flowers. They stand side by side, leaning toward each other a little, in a pumpkin patch with hay bales and orange pumpkins on the ground, golden late-afternoon light, autumn trees behind. Both are full body from the top of the sheet to the shoes, camera at chest height. Soft 35mm film photo, warm muted colors, natural grain, slight vignette, a real photo, not a costume shop picture. Vertical 9:16. Exactly two people, no text, no logos.

Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the animal's breed, size, body shape, fur color, ear shape and markings exactly the same as in the photo, so it is clearly the same pet. The pet is dressed as a little sheet ghost for the viral ghost photoshoot: a small plain white cotton sheet is draped over its head and back and falls in soft folds to its knees, with two cut-out eye holes, and its two ears poke out through small holes on top. A pair of small round black sunglasses sits on the sheet over the eye holes. Its legs, paws and tail show below the sheet and match the photo. The pet sits on the wooden steps of a front porch with carved pumpkins and orange fallen leaves around it, golden afternoon light. The whole pet is in frame, camera at the pet's eye level. Soft 35mm film photo, warm muted colors, natural grain, slight vignette, a real photo. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one animal, no people, no text, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.0 Mini, 6 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: A playful autumn clip for the ghost photoshoot trend, one continuous shot. Keep the person's face, hair, outfit and shoes exactly as in the image. The person smiles at the camera, then pulls the white bedsheet down over their face so it covers the head and body like a classic cartoon ghost, falling to just above the knees. They take the round black sunglasses and set them on the sheet where the eyes are. Then the little ghost strikes a cute pose, tilts its head and gives a small wave to the camera. Orange leaves drift down and blow across the path. The camera stays still at chest height with a slight handheld sway. Audio: soft rustling leaves, a light breeze and an original playful acoustic guitar tune. No dialogue, no lyrics, no text, no logos.
